title: Towards Responsible Development of Generative AI for Education: An Evaluation-Driven Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the standard Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ) to measure general social biases, as well as through structured human red teaming conducted in collaboration with Google's ProFair team.

bias_targets.target: Bias in teaching quality or level
bias_targets.methodology: Assessed via pedagogical rubrics and human evaluations to ensure the model adapts appropriately to the learner's proficiency without unfairly degrading the quality of education.

Measured using automated LLM-as-a-critic safety evaluations (auto-evals) to test whether the tutor inappropriately praises or responds positively to adversarial, unsafe, or discriminatory student questions.
